artifacts.notes: A born-digital fascicle with an embedded text layer. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-25 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

edition.notes: The September 2015 fascicle, which carries Francis's letter of 1 September 2015 to Archbishop Rino Fisichella on the Jubilee indulgence, including the concession of valid and licit absolution by priests of the Society of Saint Pius X, at pp. 974-976.
edition.title: Acta Apostolicae Sedis, volume 107, fascicle 9 (September 2015)

work.author: Holy See
work.description: The official gazette of the Holy See. Annual-volume editions and exact delivery artifacts remain container identities distinct from the constitutions, decrees, notifications, rescripts, and other acts printed within them.
work.title: Acta Apostolicae Sedis
